import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class CF1187G extends PrintWriter {
    CF1187G() { super(System.out); }
    
    static class FastScanner {
        private final InputStream in;
        private final byte[] buffer = new byte[1 << 15];
        private int ptr = 0, len = 0;
        
        FastScanner(InputStream in) { this.in = in; }
        
        private int read() throws IOException {
            if (ptr >= len) {
                len = in.read(buffer);
                ptr = 0;
                if (len <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[ptr++];
        }
        
        int nextInt() throws IOException {
            int c;
            while ((c = read()) <= 32) if (c == -1) return -1;
            int val = 0;
            do {
                val = val * 10 + c - '0';
            } while ((c = read()) > 32);
            return val;
        }
    }
    
    FastScanner sc;
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        CF1187G solver = new CF1187G();
        solver.sc = new FastScanner(System.in);
        solver.run();
        solver.flush();
    }
    
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    
    void run() {
        try {
            int n = sc.nextInt();
            int m = sc.nextInt();
            int k = sc.nextInt();
            int c = sc.nextInt();
            int d = sc.nextInt();
            
            int[] specialNodes = new int[k];
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
                specialNodes[i] = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            }
            
            ArrayList<Integer>[] adj = new ArrayList[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                int u = sc.nextInt() - 1;
                int v = sc.nextInt() - 1;
                adj[u].add(v);
                adj[v].add(u);
            }
            
            // Compute shortest distances from node 0 (leader's house) to all nodes
            int[] dist = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            dist[0] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
            queue.add(0);
            
            while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                int u = queue.poll();
                for (int v : adj[u]) {
                    if (dist[v] > dist[u] + 1) {
                        dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                        queue.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Calculate the cost if each person takes the shortest path
            long totalCost = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
                totalCost += (long) c * dist[specialNodes[i]];
            }
            
            // Check if using shared paths reduces cost
            // For each edge, count how many people use it in the same direction at the same time
            long sharedCost = 0;
            
            // For each person, calculate their path and count edge usage
            int[][] edgeUsage = new int[n][n]; // edgeUsage[u][v] = number of people using edge u->v at the same time step
            
            // For simplicity, assume all people take shortest paths
            // We need to track when they traverse each edge
            for (int person = 0; person < k; person++) {
                int node = specialNodes[person];
                int time = 0;
                while (node != 0) {
                    // Find a neighbor that is closer to 0
                    int nextNode = -1;
                    for (int neighbor : adj[node]) {
                        if (dist[neighbor] == dist[node] - 1) {
                            nextNode = neighbor;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (nextNode == -1) break;
                    
                    // At time 'time', person moves from node to nextNode
                    edgeUsage[node][nextNode]++;
                    node = nextNode;
                    time++;
                }
            }
            
            // Calculate additional cost from shared edges
            for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
                for (int v : adj[u]) {
                    if (dist[v] < dist[u]) { // Only consider edges going towards node 0
                        int count = edgeUsage[u][v];
                        if (count > 0) {
                            sharedCost += (long) d * count * count;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            System.out.println(totalCost + sharedCost);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}
